name: Expert Ichimoku
summary: This EA uses the Ichimoku Kinko Hyo indicator system to identify trend direction and generate trading signals. It enters long positions when price is above the cloud and the Tenkan-sen crosses above the Kijun-sen, and enters short positions under the opposite conditions. Exits are managed based on cloud crossbacks or opposing Tenkan/Kijun crosses.
summary_zh: 该EA使用一目均衡表（Ichimoku Kinko Hyo）指标系统来识别趋势方向并生成交易信号。当价格位于云层上方且转换线上穿基准线时做多，在相反条件下做空。出场基于云层穿越或转换线/基准线反向交叉来管理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA基于经典的一目均衡表（Ichimoku Kinko Hyo）系统进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件方面，做多信号要求价格位于云层（Kumo）上方，且转换线（Tenkan-sen）上穿基准线（Kijun-sen）形成金叉；做空信号则要求价格位于云层下方且转换线下穿基准线形成死叉。云层本身作为支撑/阻力区域，还起到确认趋势强度的作用——云层厚度越大，趋势越稳固。出场条件通常依赖反向的转换线/基准线交叉，或价格穿越云层边界。仓位管理方面，该EA可能使用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理方面，由于Ichimoku系统本身属于中长期趋势跟踪策略，止损通常设置在云层另一侧，但具体实现取决于参数配置。该策略的优势在于多维度确认趋势，避免了单一指标假突破的问题，但劣势在于震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs the classic Ichimoku Kinko Hyo system for trend-following trading. For entry conditions, a long signal requires price to be above the Kumo (cloud) and the Tenkan-sen to cross above the Kijun-sen (golden cross), while a short signal requires price below the cloud and the Tenkan-sen to cross below the Kijun-sen (death cross). The cloud itself acts as a support/resistance zone and confirms trend strength — thicker clouds indicate more robust trends. Exit conditions typically rely on opposing Tenkan/Kijun crosses or price crossing back through the cloud boundary. For position sizing, the EA likely uses either fixed lots or balance-proportional lot calculation. In terms of money management, since Ichimoku is inherently a medium-to-long-term trend-following system, stop losses are typically placed on the opposite side of the cloud, though the exact implementation depends on parameter configuration. The strategy's strength lies in its multi-dimensional trend confirmation, which helps avoid false breakouts from single indicators, but its weakness is the tendency to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets.

parameters.name: Tenkan_sen_period
parameters.description: 转换线周期，计算(最高价+最低价)/2

parameters.name: Kijun_sen_period
parameters.description: 基准线周期，计算(最高价+最低价)/2

parameters.name: Senkou_span_b_period
parameters.description: 先行带B周期，用于计算云层下边界
parameters.description_en: Leading span B period, for cloud lower boundary

parameters.name: LotSize
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size, used when MMRec is disabled

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: UseCloudFilter
parameters.description: 是否使用云层过滤确认趋势
parameters.description_en: Use cloud filter to confirm trend

pros: 一目均衡表提供多维度趋势确认（云层、转换线、基准线），减少假信号
经典且经过长期实战验证的技术分析系统，理论基础扎实
云层可视化支撑阻力区域，有助于判断趋势强度和关键价位
pros_en: Ichimoku provides multi-dimensional trend confirmation (cloud, Tenkan, Kijun), reducing false signals
A classic and battle-tested technical analysis system with solid theoretical foundations
Cloud visualization of support/resistance zones helps assess trend strength and key price levels
cons: 在震荡行情中，转换线与基准线频繁交叉会产生大量虚假信号和连续亏损
一目均衡表参数固定（9/26/52），缺乏自适应机制，不同品种可能需要不同参数
默认止损止盈可能为0，缺乏有效的风险控制机制
cons_en: In ranging markets, frequent Tenkan/Kijun crossovers generate many false signals and consecutive losses
Fixed Ichimoku parameters (9/26/52) lack adaptability; different instruments may require different settings
Default stop loss and take profit may be zero, lacking effective risk control mechanisms
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX或波动率指标），在震荡行情中减少交易频率
加入动态止损机制，将止损设置在云层边界而非固定点数，更符合策略逻辑
improvements_en: Add a market regime filter (e.g., ADX or volatility indicator) to reduce trading frequency in ranging markets
Implement dynamic stop losses placed at cloud boundaries rather than fixed pip values, better aligning with the strategy logic

risk_points: 默认止损可能为0，存在无止损交易的风险
震荡市中频繁假信号可能导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: Default stop loss may be zero, risking trades without protective stops
Frequent false signals in ranging markets can lead to consecutive losses
